name_reason: Compliant with global naming convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=chapter, descriptor=ch22_end_scene_char_facing_table. The 'ch22'/'22' is a meaningful chapter ID (chapters 01-30 per domain knowledge), NOT a Ghidra address residue (the table's own address is 0x52293). Name reflects both data type ('table') and semantics (per-char-slot facing directions for the chapter-22 end scene), and is consistent with sibling tables (pos_x_table/pos_y_table) and other chapters' facing tables. No address residue, no rename needed.
purpose: Chapter 22 end-scene per-character facing-direction table: one facing byte per character slot (0..15), consumed when the chapter-22 end handler places the cast and re-aims the camera.
logic_summary: Read-only const byte[16]. fd2_chapter_22_end @ 0x244B6 copies all 16 bytes (as 4 dwords via the Watcom prologue) into a stack scratch buffer 'facing[16]', then passes that buffer as arg3 (the facing argument) to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro, which indexes it by character slot. Content is uniform 0x02 except slot 1 (希爾法/Hilda) = 0x00. Values are cardinal facing directions; 0x02 is the predominant facing for this end scene. No writer anywhere in the game.
element_semantics: One byte per character slot index 0..15. Each byte is a cardinal facing-direction code (observed 0x00 and 0x02 here; full set 0x00..0x03 across sibling chapter facing tables). Slots are placed by fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro; slot 1 = 希爾法 faces 0x00, all other slots face 0x02.
notes: Ghidra data plate at 0x52293 was empty (null); created a concise PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline Java API (cu.setComment(CodeUnit.PLATE_COMMENT,...) inside a transaction) reflecting the src conclusion. src comment block in chend2.c (covering the three ch22 tables, lines ~260-279) is already precise/accurate/conclusion-style and matches the data exactly (slot 1 = 希爾法 = 0x00 corroborated by the consumer's post-action lose-if-char[1]-dead note), so it was left unmodified (no Edit to chend2.c; git working tree unchanged for that file). Memory verified via Ghidra read: [2,0,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2] == src definition. Datatype byte[16] confirmed; next symbol at 0x522A3 is data_fd2_chapter_ch23_end_scene_char_pos_x_table (byte[17]), so the 16-byte extent is correct. Only xrefs are READ/DATA from fd2_chapter_22_end -> genuinely read-only -> const is correct.
